# Laksh Advani

> Staff Applied Scientist at ServiceNow in Seattle. Works on the reliability of LLM agents: silent failures, verifying reasoning, and reading an agent's plan from its hidden states. 8+ years in applied ML.

## Profile
- Role: Staff Applied Scientist, ServiceNow (2024–present); previously Applied Scientist, Qualtrics (2021–2024)
- Education: M.S. Computer Science, University of Colorado Boulder
- Interests: LLM agents and verification; evaluation and LLM-as-judge; RLHF and preference optimization; efficient inference
- Contact: laksh.edu@gmail.com

## Selected projects
- Agentic IT service management: Agents that resolve IT service requests end to end in production
- Catching silent failures: Checks that flag when an agent claims success it didn't achieve
- Reading the Plan: 75% fewer LLM calls via confidence gating
- Post-training at scale: DPO, PPO and QLoRA pipelines for large language models
- Neuro-symbolic syllogisms: Top 3, SemEval 2026 Task 11 Subtask 1
- Domain LLMs at Qualtrics: GPT-4 parity on internal benchmarks, 80% lower operating cost on-prem
